reason: The product owner explicitly requires every generated and documented Gluetun service to use qmcgaw/gluetun:latest so provider server updates arrive without a Tuniku release.
security_assessment: The exception is limited to the Gluetun integration image. Tuniku itself and all build inputs remain digest-pinned. pull_policy is always, generated configuration is provider-validated, server data can be refreshed independently, and the release process tests the then-current latest image. Mutable upstream behavior remains a compatibility and supply-chain risk and must be reviewed on the stated date.
tests: runtime generation and startup smoke test with qmcgaw/gluetun:latest
